_comment: Conformance fixture: binding verified at snapshot A viewed at snapshot B without automatic verification (ADR-0010 §Binding Lineage)
description: A BindingEvidence accepted at GraphSnapshot A must not be treated as verified at GraphSnapshot B without an explicit RevalidateBinding event.

expected_behavior.explanation: Without an explicit RevalidateBinding event, the binding remains evidence only for snapshot A. Viewing it at B does not create new verification.
